headline: China EV Adoption Rate Expected to Exceed 70% in November
summary: Electric vehicle adoption in China is projected to top 70% of total car sales in November, as consumer preference shifts away from petrol-powered vehicles in the world's largest automotive market.
why: This rapid transition significantly impacts global automotive manufacturers, battery supply chains, and oil demand, forcing a structural shift in the industry.

impacts.name: Electric Vehicles
impacts.why: High adoption rates indicate strong growth for the EV sector.
